mathematics.assertion_tested: Direct point counts at every smooth coefficient pair over F11 and F19 reproduce the declared polynomials and exclude respectively eigenvalues +1 and -1 modulo seven; explicit ray quotient has order eight and the stated unit kernel.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers, F11 and F19, quadratic extensions by i^2=-1, residual evaluations in F7, and finite abelian groups.
mathematics.conventions: Arithmetic Frobenius, constant-term-first polynomials, two rational infinity points for the monic sextic.
non_claims: No global irreducibility without the written character contract and Frobenius bridge.
No audit of the twelve other auxiliary primes.
